svg.title: Figure 17 · Implied versus local volatility
svg.desc: Reference SSVI. Local variance equals partial-T total variance at fixed k divided by g(k), under deterministic proportional carry and the smooth local-diffusion assumptions. All shown values use analytic derivatives.
